ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 high-intensity (cream/white) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly symmetrical high-intensity (cream) contiguous blobs occupying the central and lateral regions of both lobes, bifurcated by a wide, low-intensity (black) vertical corridor extending from the peduncle to the median notch. The perimeter is defined by a low-intensity (black) border of varying thickness.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes. A distinct, high-amplitude notch (missing segment) is visible on the far-left trailing edge approximately 10% inward from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending towards the distal tips along the trailing edge, paired with a convex sweep along the leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and sparsely along the lower trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity (black) unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity cream zones. The left lobe exhibits a prominent curvilinear mark and several shorter diagonal scratches; the right lobe contains fewer, shorter linear marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant notch or traumatic indentation on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe. Extensive linear rake marks are visible on the interior of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique arrangement of three distinct circular low-intensity spots on the upper-left high-intensity lobe, forming a triangular pattern.
